messages:
ana: FYI partner wants a minimal OTEL->Datadog pattern for our marketplace appliance docs. They asked for span naming conventions and a tiny example config that works air-gapped.

mike: Proposed span prefixes: hw.inference.request, hw.model.tokenize, hw.model.generate. Add resource tags: hw.vendor, hw.serial, hw.gpu_count.

oliver: I'll create a 10-line collector snippet that writes to file and includes an example datadog exporter commented out. Also add a short note: traces opt-in for private bundles.

dd-integ-bot: Datadog checklist entry created: marketplace-airgap-telemetry. Link: https://internal.datadog/partners/ri-marketplace-airgap

ana: Great. Keep it concise; legal needs a PII redaction note. Mike, can you draft that blurb?

mike: Yep: "Operators must strip or hash user identifiers before exporting. Authorization headers are removed by default in the sample config."

oliver: I'll push the snippet to GH and attach here when ready. ETA today.
